annotations.text:
Pinned rail as a mixer.
Each pin is a track; the track IS its fader. What you drew sits inside it, laid flat. Focus + tether make the faders move by themselves (violet). Sort = the selected pin, so row one is always what unpin takes.

The middle artboard is live — click into it.
Try: all ↔ focus · tether off · M on a loop (the playhead keeps going) · drag a bar · tap a number to fold it open · the sort
